texts: Tessa Brae walks every part of the base of the cliff each morning during the molting season.
The collectors record the collection in a Watch ledger each morning.

fields.sentence: Tessa Brae walks every part of the base of the cliff each morning during the molting season.
parse: (: walk_rule (Implication (PartOf $y sk_base_1) (And (Member (sk_walk $y) walk) (Agent (sk_walk $y) tessa_brae) (Theme (sk_walk $y) $y) (Time (sk_walk $y) morning) (Every (sk_walk $y) 1 day) (During (sk_walk $y) sk_molting_season_1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Object-universal routed as the shared-subject rule form (the ExistsForall shape), premise (PartOf $y sk_base_1) matching the 'every member of the committee' range, with the frequency slot Time morning + Every 1 day and the During interval inside the consequent. 'each morning' gets no QuantifierPhrase companion, which matches the Time section's habitual-schedule examples rather than the Quantifiers companion rule.

fields.sentence: The collectors record the collection in a Watch ledger each morning.
parse: (: lo27_rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) (And (Member (sk_record $x) record) (Agent (sk_record $x) $x) (Theme (sk_record $x) sk_collection_1) (Location (sk_record $x) sk_ledger_1) (Time (sk_record $x) morning) (Every (sk_record $x) 1 day))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: inscription-medium "in" on a recording verb ("record the collection in a ledger"): the instruction set lists Location for event-side "in/at/on", but also routes document-like "in a statement" to the preposition-named In oblique, and never says which applies when the "in" names the written medium rather than a place
review.notes: Group event plus the PartOf per-member rule (1.0/0.9), the Northgate-style Possession + Name handling of the proper-noun premodifier in "a Watch ledger", Theme for the merely-recorded object, and (Time e morning) + (Every e 1 day) with no tense atom for the habitual all follow the instruction set. The only open point is Location vs In for the ledger.
